longLine.text: This line is {{length}} columns, a tab counted as four, and the house limit is {{limit}}. A line past the limit runs off the edge of a review pane or a split editor, so its end, where the detail often sits, goes unread. Break it at a natural seam, after a comma or after an operator, since Go ends a statement at a line that ends in a name, a literal or a closing bracket, and wrap a comment onto the next line.
